_comment: Assisto DICTIONARY (feature 39) ADVANCED upgrade. {key:[bn,en]} -> camelCase getters after gen-l10n. Snake-case {q}/{src}/{n} are ICU placeholders. The dictionary CONTENT (bn headwords, examples, synonyms, pronunciation) comes from the backend open-license/sample dataset and is rendered at runtime — it is NOT in this file. These keys are UI CHROME only. Bangla digits are rendered at runtime from codepoints in Dart (no Bangla literals in .dart). LICENSING: open-license data ONLY; NEVER Bangla Academy or any proprietary dictionary. Merge [0]->app_bn.arb, [1]->app_en.arb, then flutter gen-l10n.
